critical_issues: $200 minimum cleaning fee deducted from deposit
Early termination requires 2 months rent + forfeit all deposit ($7,200 total)
$10/day late fee accumulates quickly ($300/month if 30 days late)
$60/month total pet rent for 2 pets ($1,080 over lease)
No cure period mentioned for some defaults
rationale: This lease has some concerning provisions (high early termination penalty, non-refundable pet deposits, minimum cleaning fees) but also positive elements (early termination option, cure period, reasonable term). The $7,200 early termination cost is substantial but at least provides an exit option.
required_changes: Reduce early termination to 1.5 months rent without deposit forfeiture
Add cure period for all defaults
